# E-M10 colour wheel in Color Creator, version 87

The owner reports a 12-sector Hue/Saturation/Lightness wheel in Color Creator at the ART dial working on their E-M10 Mark I.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 (Mark I)](../cameras/em10.md) · **Project:** [om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M10 firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-1400.md) · **Mod build:** 87

In version 87 on firmware 1.4, Color Creator at the ART dial position shows a wheel of 12 sectors, each with Hue, Saturation and Lightness from -7 to +7; the recipe applies to JPEG and live view, survives power-off and does not apply in P, A, S or M.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M10 version 87: owner field test](../evidence/em10-v87-owner.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; release label only.

## Limits

- One owner camera; no per-feature results or test date.
- The ART dial no longer reaches the stock art filters; they are chosen through Picture Mode in P, A, S or M.
- After a RAW Data Edit, a wheel key press or re-entering ART is needed before the recipe applies, although the guide can already read RECIPE ON.
- Very dark and very pale pixels in an edited sector can spread a little into neighbouring colours; the ART mode guide still shows the P icon.
